chunks: God is cognisant of what every female carries in her womb, or what the wombs want or exceed (of their disburdening time). With Him all things are in determined measure.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge of pregnancy and biological processes?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Ra'd is often cited to demonstrate God's omniscience extending to the subtle, unseen biological changes within the womb, affirming His precise decree (Qadr) over all natural processes. It underscores the divine attribute of Al-Alim (The All-Knowing) in both the macrocosm of creation and the microcosm of human gestation, linking physical reality to spiritual determinism.
